companyFieldUpdates.description: TXNM Energy, Inc. is the Albuquerque, New Mexico-based public holding company above regulated electric utilities Public Service Company of New Mexico and Texas-New Mexico Power. The platform serves residential, commercial and industrial customers in New Mexico and Texas through rate-regulated generation, transmission and distribution infrastructure. The corporation was incorporated in 2000, established its holding-company structure in 2001 and changed its name from PNM Resources to TXNM Energy in August 2024. Blackstone Infrastructure signed an agreement on May 19, 2025 to acquire 100% of TXNM. A separate $400 million PIPE for eight million shares closed on June 2, 2025, but a New Mexico order caused those shares to be cancelled and the investment repaid on July 22, 2026. TXNM therefore remains publicly owned while the take-private remains signed and pending regulatory approvals. No specific final Blackstone fund allocation or legal closing date is publicly disclosed.
